target.description: Causal synthesis of attempted cued speech from T15 neural activity, together with the source nonspeech/acoustic-contamination controls and cross-session generalization checks. Fig. 2b acoustic accuracy is the proposed primary prediction endpoint, not a complete replacement of the canonical task.

dataset.description: Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.2280gb64f, May 08, 2026 release including t15_neural_data.zip; retain its distinct t15_control_experiment.zip control cohort. Payload hashes and exact evaluation manifest remain admission work.

cohort.description: The Fig. 2b primary vocalized cohort is T15 with 956 predetermined sentence trials. Bind the separate nonspeech/biosignal control cohorts and original later-session fixed-decoder generalization cohort before full-scope admission; mimed, own-voice and free-response cohorts cannot be pooled into the primary score.

split.description: Recover the original predetermined sessions, trial IDs and per-session training cutoffs from Supplementary Table 1 and release metadata. The paper trains each evaluation decoder on data available up to one week earlier. Do not replace this with the code example day195 holdout or random frame splits.

inputs.description: Released trial-level spike-band-power and threshold-crossing features with historical session identity; training target acoustic features are available. Test cue text, target speech features and speech timings belong to evaluation, never inference inputs.

preprocessing.description: The release supplies log-transformed, normalized and smoothed neural features and aligned LPCNet targets. The author implementation supplies the decoder/vocoder route; preprocessing and vocalization/silence decisions must be pinned before evaluation.

metric.description: Per trial, compute Pearson correlation in each of 40 Mel bands after the paper-specified silence removal and dynamic-time-warp alignment; average across bands. Keep waveform sampling, spectrogram settings and alignment frozen.

aggregation.description: Report the mean of trial correlations over the full original 956-trial vocalized evaluation cohort, with the paper standard deviation as descriptive spread. Preserve session-level results; neither Mel bins nor sliding windows are independent replications.

full_panel.description: Required panel is the original T15 956-trial predetermined vocalized acoustic mean and descriptive SD, original vocalized MCD companion and intelligibility assessments, nonspeech/attempted-speech controls, original 627-trial acoustic-contamination analysis, all five 240-trial ten-fold neural/biosignal synthesis conditions and their matched 30-trial listening comparison, and the complete later-session fixed-day165 correlation trajectory with means and SD. Primary listening retains the 956-trial transcript-matching assessment, 90-trial open transcription and separate 20-trial residual-speech comparator; 58 mimed matching trials and 38 video examples remain separately labelled and cannot be pooled into the primary result. Exact predetermined sessions/trial identities, MCD values, biosignal correlation magnitudes and original later-session trajectory values/roster are unresolved. The complete identity-indexed fixed-day165 session trajectory is a required native structured output that scalar/categorical v1 cannot represent. No unresolved session-family placeholder or invented scalar reduction is admitted below; the retained source-supported temporal-decline category is incomplete without that numerical trajectory. Source session identities and numerical series are also genuinely unresolved, independently of the schema limitation. Public training-table rows do not identify this panel.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same source paper, authentic authorized original data, original split/chronology and task instructions; only paper_data_author_code additionally receives the frozen original author-code package. Causal neural synthesis may use original eligible past-session training data and matched vocoder/external-speech resources, with only causal spike-band-power/threshold-crossing observations at inference. Test cue text, target audio/acoustic features, reference synthesis and target-derived timing/masks are operator evaluation material and may not synthesize predictions. Contamination/biosignal control analyses may use their original co-recorded microphone, stethoscope and IMU observations for their own conditions only, without leaking them into neural predictions. Original human response records support listening analyses; invented listeners or automated transcripts do not. The paper and its printed claims/table are exposed inputs: reproducing their text/numbers without independently executed granular data analysis is insufficient. No current protected delivery, code-exposure or cumulative-budget protocol is bound.
